name: DataTable
description: A feature-rich data table component with sorting, filtering, and pagination. Built on semantic HTML table elements with accessible column headers and interactive controls.

notes: Sortable column headers are rendered as buttons with aria-sort indicating current sort state.
The table uses a <caption> derived from an internal accessible description.
Loading state announces via aria-busy on the table element.
Empty state message is presented in a table cell spanning all columns.
Focus indicator uses var(--color-border-focus) on sortable headers.

columns.description: REQUIRED. Array of column definitions including key, title, optional sortable flag, optional width, and optional render function.

data.description: REQUIRED. Array of data objects to display as rows.

sortable.description: When true, enables sorting on columns that have sortable set to true.

resizable.description: When true, columns can be resized by dragging column borders.

loading.description: When true, displays a loading state overlay on the table.

emptyMessage.description: Message displayed when the data array is empty.

className.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element.

do: Provide meaningful column titles for accessibility.
Use the render function for custom cell rendering when needed.
Use the loading prop while data is being fetched.
Use emptyMessage to provide helpful guidance when no data is present.
dont: Do not use DataTable for non-tabular content — use List or Grid instead.
Do not place complex interactive widgets inside cells — keep cells focused on data display.
